raw_segments.text: Drink and pass, he cried, handing the heavy-charged flagon to the nearest seamen.
The crew alone now drink, round with it round, short drafts, long swallows, men, tease hot
as Satan's hoof, so-so it goes round excellently.
It spiralizes and ye forks out at the serpent-snapping eye, well done, almost drained.
That way it went, this way it comes.
